title: Rebirth & Reclaim
flavor: The Wraith King’s body had been totally destroyed after times of death. But he pinned his only hope on an ancient ceremony called Rebirth Eve. At that moment, the aurora sweeps over the land with a dazzling radiance. All undeads can rebirth and even derive a new talent with the aurora essence. Aegis of Immortal, found as a special offering, will play an important part, when the Wraith King reclaim his throne. Will he surprise us all?

entries.name: Deathrattle
entries.detail: A unified definition - Effect on a chess piece killed. (Including Resurrect, Aegis of Immortal, Bloodthrone, Infection, Soul Leech etc.)

entries.name: All illusion pieces cannot trigger Battlecry now
Only Tier 4 & Tier 5 items will be broadcast in bullet (to avoid too many info bullets)
Wraith King($4, Undead/Warrior)
entries.detail: Ability: Spectral Blade <Passive Skill> Wraith King’s form regroups after death, allowing him to reincarnate when killed. <Passive Skill> Wraith King’s cursed attack deals additional pure damage after a short delay, with a fixed damage and a percentage of his attack damage. Cursed debuff cannot be stacked. Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.

entries.name: Clinkz($2, Undead/Hunter)
entries.detail: Ability: Burning Barrage <Active Skill: Activate on Full Mana> Clinkz shoots multiple burning arrows that hit all enemies in a line. Every shot deals his physical attack damage. It’s hard to say whether the blur around the Bone Fletcher is from his flaming heart or his speed with the quiver.

entries.name: Necrophos - Reaper’s Scythe
entries.detail: “Prevent its victim from deathrattle” added, “Death Pulse” removed. <Active Skill: Activate on Full Mana> Stun and deal pure damage to an enemy with his Reaper’s Scythe and prevent its victim from deathrattle. Damage dealt is positively related to the lost health of the victim.

entries.name: Undead - Plague
entries.detail: Reworked (3) Undeads: All non-undead pieces of both sides in the battle gain the plague effect: maximum health -10%. (6) Undeads: All non-undead pieces of both sides in the battle gain the plague effect: maximum health -40%. (9) Undeads: All plague-infected pieces have a certain lifespan and will suicide.

entries.name: Ascetic’s Cap, now Tier 1 instead of Tier 2
entries.detail: Reworked ★ or ★★ Non-undead carrier gains: If the carrier survives a home battle, it will resurrect into a random undead piece of the same cost at the beginning of next round. *At most 1 undead piece can resurrect each round. *Resurrect buff is settled when battle starts. Chess pieces given the cap during battle cannot resurrect this round. *★★★ Pieces and IO cannot resurrect. Independ with Dismiss. An austere cap from Undery.

entries.detail: Deathrattle: Resurrect once after death. Immortals used to have a magical shield to prevent them from death.
